<color=#ffd680>Elemental Skill</color>
Deal 2 <color=#ffe699>Geo DMG</color> and generate 2 stacks of <color=#ffffff>Efficient Switch</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Efficient Switch</color>
<color=#ffd680>Combat Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>The next time you perform "Switch Character":</color> Spend 1 fewer Elemental Die. (Can stack, no stack limit)

<color=#ffd680>Elemental Burst</color>
Deal 3 <color=#ffe699>Geo DMG</color> , as well as generate <color=#ffffff>Low Gravity Background</color> and <color=#ffffff>Shock Blast</color> . During this Round, all your characters on standby use 1 less <color=#ffffff>Unaligned Element</color> when using their next <color=#ffffff>Normal Attack</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Low Gravity Background</color>
<color=#ffd680>Combat Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>After either side uses a Skill:</color> Attaches <color=#ffffff>Evasion</color> to this character and switches to the next character.
<color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds): 2</color>
<color=#ebe4d8>Shock Blast</color>
<color=#ffd680>Combat Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>End Phase:</color> Deal 1 <color=#ffffff>Piercing DMG</color> to all opposing characters who have not been afflicted by <color=#ffffff>Evasion</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds): 2</color>

Reacts with Elements if they are already applied:
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Cryo Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Pyro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Electro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)

<color=#ebe4d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ebe4d8>Duration (Rounds)</color>
Each time you reach the end of a Round, <color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds)</color> -1.
This card will be discarded immediately once <color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds)</color> runs out.
<color=#ebe4d8>Piercing DMG</color>
Piercing DMG cannot be increased by any bonuses, but cannot be defended against using Shields or DMG Immunity either.
<color=#ebe4d8>Unaligned Element</color>
You may use Elemental Dice of any element to pay this type of cost.

value.name: Experimental Field Generator
value.desc:
A large device designed by the late Edwin Eastinghouse. It has the ability to "counteract" the effects of gravity. According to the original design intentions, this was the first step in a plan to turn Fontaine into a city in the sky, so never again would the people have to worry about the waves that once swept over the land. Even if all seven nations were to be swallowed by the deeps, the elegant Court of Fontaine would float above it all, just like Celestia. Even the secrets of the universe would no longer seem so distant.

The Arkhium in the device's core has the characteristics of "splitting" or "precipitation," and can take matter, or certain things outside of matter, and separate them. It is said that this process can be reversed, but the Fontaine Research Institute is infatuated only with the physical effects it can produce.
